title: Caterpillar transforms into a Butterfly at start of battle
notes: The Turtle pack has no transform pet, so this one fixture uses Caterpillar from the Puppy pack. Caterpillar and Butterfly are both core game pets, so there is no unknown-pet degradation risk. The strongest enemy is the BACK one, so the copied stats are visibly not the stats of the pet the Butterfly is about to fight.
